name: Vitamin B6
description: Vitamin B6 (CAS 8059-24-3 ), commonly supplied in its pyridoxine hydrochloride form, is a water-soluble B-complex vitamin used across food, pharmaceutical, and animal nutrition industries. It functions as a coenzyme precursor supporting amino acid metabolism, making it a target ingredient for nutritional fortification and supplement manufacturing for global clients. In dietary supplements and multivitamin formulations, Vitamin B6 is dosed to meet established RDA targets for human nutrition labeling and health claims in various markets. Food and beverage manufacturers incorporate it into fortified cereals, energy drinks, and infant formula to meet regulatory nutrient requirements and consumer health demands. Pharmaceutical producers use it as an active ingredient in B-complex tablets, injectables, and prenatal preparations. In animal feed, it is added to poultry and swine rations. Vitamin B6 is commercially available as a white crystalline powder, predominantly as pyridoxine hydrochloride. Standard grades include USP , BP , and Ph. Eur. specifications. Food-grade ( FCC ) options are also available, with the pharmaceutical grades being the most commonly specified for supplement and drug applications across the industry. Bulk supply is typically offered in kilogram and metric ton quantities to suit both formulation-scale and large industrial procurement needs for international distribution.
